Container.Name: my-echo-server
Container.Overview: Lightweight self-hosted Hi-Fi music server for Unraid and Docker. Indexes your NAS music library locally into fast SQLite & gzip delta shards, includes a dark-neon Web Player with on-the-fly BPM & loudness normalization, hosts an AI Radio DJ (powered by Google Gemini with live web-grounded music facts and voice intros/outros), runs a zero-install Party Mode Guest Jukebox with mobile DJ Voice Intros, streams live MP3 radio & casts to LAN DLNA speakers/TVs, supports built-in Cloudflare Tunnel & UPnP/NAT-PMP remote access, integrates with Lidarr, and pairs natively with My Echo for macOS, iOS, and Apple TV.

Config.Name: API & WebUI Port
Config.Description: Main API, Web Player, AI Radio DJ, DLNA streams, and Admin WebUI.

Config.Name: Party Mode HTTP Port
Config.Description: Zero-install Party Mode Guest Web Jukebox (QR code URL).

Config.Name: Party Mode HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Companion HTTPS listener for mobile Safari/Chrome DJ Voice Intro microphone recording.

Config.Name: AppData Config
Config.Description: Stores SQLite database, pre-built compressed index shards, artwork thumbnail cache, DJ audio cache, TLS cert, and config.json.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Primary Unraid music share (rw allows mirroring compressed index shards & auto-discovery beacon into .myecho/; ro is also supported).

Config.Name: Server Display Name
Config.Description: Name displayed in the Web UI, DLNA MediaServer, Party Mode, and My Echo clients.

Config.Name: Advertise Host (Unraid LAN/Tailscale IP)
Config.Description: Optional Unraid LAN IP used for DLNA stream URLs and Party Mode QR codes (recommended if your server has multiple NICs or runs in bridge mode).

Config.Name: 6-Digit Pairing PIN
Config.Description: Optional fixed 6-digit PIN for remote login and Mac/Apple TV pairing (auto-generated on first boot if blank).

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: Incremental scan interval (e.g. 30m, 2h, 24h, or manual for Lidarr webhook-only disk spin-down friendliness).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Local timezone (e.g. Europe/Oslo, America/New_York) used for AI DJ time-of-day awareness and Party Mode schedules.

Config.Name: Legacy Mac SMB Prefix (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional macOS SMB mount prefix (e.g. /Volumes/Media/MUSIC) so server Track IDs match existing My Echo Mac playlists and ratings 1:1.
